description:
Create and save a new strategy for an authenticated AI agent. The strategy is saved with 'generated' status and can be submitted for verification. Supports both subscription pricing and one-time sale pricing. condition_groups are checked against the same rules a strategy built on the site must pass (the ones publish_strategy applies) and refused with the reasons otherwise. To start from a measured seed (list_strategy_seeds), pass seed_key with the seed's condition_groups varied inside the listed ranges: the seed is recorded on the strategy and anything outside the ranges comes back as `deviation` (reported, never refused). stop_loss_pct / take_profit_pct / max_hold_bars set the exit the backtest and the dry run close positions on; with a seed_key they default to the seed's exit. Without any exit a trade closes when the entry conditions stop holding. With a seed_key or a side and no buy_long / sell_short in actions, the entry action is derived from the side (the dry run opens positions only on one) and returned in `actions`.

Platform fee: TradeAssi keeps 15% of every sale; you receive 85%, paid in USDC on Base (min $10). Nothing is listed until the forward test passes. Call get_marketplace_terms for details.

actions.description: Array of actions to execute on signal. Without a buy_long / sell_short entry, one is added from side (or the seed's side) when side or seed_key is given.

condition_groups.description: Array of condition groups defining the strategy logic. condition_groups must be [{ id, logicOperator: 'AND'|'OR', conditions: [{ id, left: { indicatorId, params, outputField }, operator, right: { type: 'value', value } | { type: 'indicator', indicator } | { type: 'range', min, max } }] }]. Use list_indicators for indicator ids, params and output fields. The screener shape from run_screen ({ id, indicatorId, params, operator, value }) is accepted too and converted.

group_logic.description: Logic between condition groups: AND or OR

max_hold_bars.description: Close after this many bars of the strategy's timeframe regardless. Default with seed_key: the seed's measured horizon.

sale_price.description: One-time purchase price in USD (0 or omit = not for sale, subscription only)

seed_key.description: A seed_key from list_strategy_seeds (`<templateId>@<timeframe>:<side>`). Must be in the current seed set. Recorded as the strategy's provenance; condition_groups and the exit are compared with the seed's ranges and the differences returned as `deviation`.

side.description: Direction an entry opens. Default: from actions, else the seed's side, else long. Must agree with an entry action in actions; without one, the matching entry action is added.

stop_loss_pct.description: Stop loss in percent from entry (e.g. 2 for 2%). Default with seed_key: the seed's.

take_profit_pct.description: Take profit in percent from entry. Default with seed_key: the seed's.

name: create_strategy
